env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Every const composite fixture runs the same natively and ejected, and the ejected program builds with Go 1.27.2.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cd a
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_composite_spread.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_composite_spread.out
cd ..
rm out

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_composite_index_literal.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
